query: Let `T : E →L[𝕜] E` be a compact self-adjoint operator on a complete inner product space `E`. Then the orthogonal complement of `⨆ μ, eigenspace T μ` (the closed span of all eigenspaces) is `⊥`, i.e. the eigenspaces of `T` together span a dense subspace of `E`.
